newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weaker on dollar, firmer on pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weaker on dollar, firmer on pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee was fixed slightly weaker against the dollar and stronger against the pound on Thursday, reflecting international trends, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was posted at a mean commercial bank rate of 20.1860 against the dollar from 20.1285 last Wednesday, and at 33.2245 against the pound from 33.2545 on Wednesday.
Dealers said they were waiting for U.S. employment figures on Friday. They said the money market in Mauritius was currently quiet with low demand for hard currencies.
